original_card.question: Can one precisely specified helper-mixing word satisfy a replacement for the inherited H2/K interface?
methods: Derive a replacement interface lemma and price its implementation.
Seek an exact dirty-input or chronological-cut counterexample to the proposed replacement.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A full boundary contract and paid profile; unchanged scalar counts alone are insufficient.

first_step.inspect: Compare the two false H2/K flags with the unchanged paid profile in its README.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Write one replacement H2/K implication for a single helper-star operation, then try to falsify it on dirty inputs.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A legitimate replacement could admit a cheaper bit circuit; scalar savings alone do not alter the selected moment.
allowed_variations: Choose one helper-star or quartet instance; narrow to one boundary implication.
scope_change_triggers: Changing only source count or scalar addition count without an interface argument.

actual_scope: D-local H1 relaxation, four helpers and four targets: exact minimum unit-cost single-source XOR count of the fully restored dirty shear (h,y) -> (h,y+Kh) for all 65,536 binary 4-by-4 K, with and without target feedback into helpers, eight arbitrary dirty registers and no extra registers.
scope_change_reason: PR1194/PR1311 already treat the card's original H2/K question on a fixed word while retaining H1 inside D. PR1306 (merged) isolated that retained restriction in a fully restored zero-frame prefix and settled 1 <= H,T <= 3; open PR1557 settled 3-by-4 and named four helpers and four targets as the next question. This package answers that handoff in the same model and alphabets.
bottleneck_link: A strictly cheaper feedback prefix would be a legal D-local scalar saving under PR1306's substitution lemma, which could then be priced for precision, hosting and the paid profile. The census finds no gate-count gain for any 4-by-4 K, so this finite domain cannot supply that improvement. Side result for the bit supplier; the bit side does not bind and no kappa is claimed.
stop_rule: Stop once every labeled 4-by-4 K has an attained restricted word and an exact unrestricted shorter-word exclusion; if the radius-5 census plus targeted radius-6 checks cannot resolve every K, report the exact coverage without a minimum claim.
evidence: CERTIFICATE.json: all 65,536 K in 317 row/column orbits; minimum histogram [1,16,120,560,1820,4416,8452,13040,16002,14372,6329,384,24], maximum 12 (the 24 matrices J-P), zero feedback gains. Primary: coset meet-in-the-middle census to ten gates in both alphabets, restricted sphere-6 and symmetry-reduced unrestricted checks beyond ten, attaining witnesses, PR1306 3x3 and PR1557 3x4 reproductions and eleven controls. Independent: column-packed per-orbit lookups, last-gate normalization for J-I and 65,536 transported witnesses replayed on all 256 dirty inputs. An unreduced 56-gate scan (not registered; about 8 minutes) also found no 11-gate J-I word. Exploratory (uncertified): all other shapes with at most eight registers left open by PR1306/PR1557 are elementwise equal via verify.py --shape.

open_questions.question: Does target feedback ever lower the minimum for any H and T (a general no-feedback theorem, i.e. geodesic convexity of the block-lower-triangular parabolic subgroup of GL(H+T,2) for unit transvections), or does a counterexample appear beyond eight registers?
open_questions.why_it_matters: A proof would close the D-local feedback relaxation as a source of scalar savings for every prefix size; a counterexample would give the first legal cheaper prefix to price physically.
open_questions.first_step: Certify the exploratory shapes with at most eight registers (1x4, 1x5, 2x4, 1x6, 2x5, 1x7, 2x6, 3x5, already elementwise equal via verify.py --shape; transposes equivalent by M -> M^-T) with witnesses and an independent check, then seek a structural reason in the incompressible extremal J-P family.
open_questions.blocked_by: No proof idea yet; nine registers (4x5, 3x6) need radius-6 unrestricted balls (hundreds of millions of matrices) or a new reduction.
